---
title: "Known consolidation issues"
---

Master Book v1.05 records several active consolidation concerns. These are not silently “fixed” by documentation.

## ResearchOS-era sediment

Older specifications and terminology still exist. The proposed archive pass is deliberate and should happen only after authority is settled; this website therefore labels the Master Book as normative and preserves source-local material as secondary reference.

## Scattered module documentation

The source contains README, validation, roadmap, patch and release-note material of mixed age. This refreshed site indexes those files rather than pretending every one has equal authority.

## Lane consistency

Method metadata and UI lane placement may drift. Lane display should derive from current metadata consistently.

## Exchange-rate issue

The Master Book records duplicate/ambiguous currency labels and value handling problems for non-1 exchange amounts as an open issue.

## Home / Done and closeout

Origin-aware completion has had regressions. The intended rule remains: app/preset → dashboard; widget → desktop; ODK → ODK; protocol/schedule → their runners.

## Protocol/schedule completion

Closeout semantics have improved for individual capabilities and presets, but protocols and schedules remain a central architectural priority.
